details.description:
Love the frothy, creamy coffee you get at cafes, but not getting it quite right at home? Introducing Tata Coffee Cafe Specials, an all-new instant coffee mix crafted to make deliciously creamy & frothy Cafe style coffee in the comfort of your home. Its special foaming creamer instantly boosts the texture of your coffee to give you the layer of froth you love and a creaminess down to the last sip.
Make in 3 easy steps:
Empty the powder from the sachet into a cup. Take 180 ml of hot milk for a perfect cup.
Add half the milk from a height & stir gently for a few seconds.
Pour the remaining milk from a height & stir.
Your cup of frothy, creamy Cafe style coffee is ready to enjoy.
